fields.note: The p_cl-matched 5052-O face (3.103 mm on a 20.929 mm core, h held) reproduces beryllium's elastic gamma within +2.8% and its core-shear onset within +2.6%. Its outer face reaches yield at 0.88 of beryllium's pressure; the operating-stress ratio matches to 0.99. Not matched: biaxial membrane stiffness (+31%, from nu 0.33 against 0.0752), the wrinkle margin (x4.0, so wrinkling is suppressed), beryllium's low-ductility fracture, and the line's Be compression premise (the match uses the 345 MPa tensile proxy). A Be confirmation article is needed before any qualification claim.
fields.proposed_fix: Re-match the stand-in thickness after 038 T1 measures SR-200 compression.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
